name: Luna
source: Rune’s twin younger brother. He is weak, gentle, and kind-hearted. Unlike Rune, he cannot fly, which is a source of insecurity. He has a healing ability that allows him to heal injuries by holding out his hand. Frustrated by how little he can do compared to Rune, he constantly seeks ways to contribute in his own way.
